notes: PixeliusVita Fantasy Monster07 (the gloamgarden guardian repaint). Native Idle, Walk, Run, Attack and Hit kept. The native Monster07_Die.anim cannot ship: sampled straight from its curves (no root motion: m_HasGenericRootTransform 0, the root position curve holds y 0), it ends with root.x at 0.017 m and the toes 0.57 m below the root plane, where Monster08/09's Die (same library, same sampling) end with root.x at 0.12 m and the legs about 0.2 m down; only a lift track could show it. Death is retargeted from the Monster09 Die (the four-winged flyer with the same skeleton family), rest-relative to each body's own Idle, landed on the floor.
